title: Presentation on the closed quotient with proper first support
statement: Let X be Noetherian, f:X -> S locally of finite type, Q and K quasi-coherent ideals, and M a coherent Q-adic formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Assume K annihilates M, the first support is proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and no proper closed subscheme of X annihilates M. With j:V(K) -> X [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], there exists G in Coh(V(K),Q O_V(K)) and an isomorphism M ~= j_*G of inverse systems. The first support of G is proper over S and V(K) is nonempty.

source.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4 (closed quotient, Chow modification, projective algebraization and proper push-pull comparison); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E

proof.text: Use the formal closed-immersion equivalence for j=K.subschemeι. Since j.ker=K, M defines an object of its supported full subcategory. Set G to the inverse equivalence applied to that object. The counit and the natural comparison with termwise pushforward compose to give M.obj ~= G.obj composed with pushforward j.

Apply the coherent closed-pushforward support formula to the first term of G. Evaluation of the system isomorphism and the stalk functor give bijections of stalks, hence preserve Subsingleton. Thus Supp(M_1)=j(Supp(G_1)). Injectivity of j makes Supp(G_1)=j^{-1}(Supp(M_1)). Proper-preimage preservation for the proper closed immersion j shows that this closed subset is proper over S.

If V(K) is empty, every morphism out of it is a closed immersion and therefore proper. In particular j followed by f is proper, while j.ker=K annihilates M, contrary to the hypothesis. Return the constructed G, its system isomorphism, its proper support, and nonemptiness.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4; this node isolates presentation on the closed quotient with proper first support.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_closedQuotientFormalPresentation
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (Q K : X.IdealSheafData) (M : CoherentFormalModule X Q)
    (hK : AnnihilatedBy Q K M)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (M.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (hP : ¬ ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z ⟶ X) (_ : IsClosedImmersion j),
      IsProper (j ≫ f) ∧ AnnihilatedBy Q j.ker M) :
    ∃ G : @CoherentFormalModule K.subscheme
        (isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType K.subschemeι) (Q.comap K.subschemeι),
      Nonempty (M.obj ≅ G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward K.subschemeι) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver (K.subschemeι ≫ f) (G.obj.obj (op 0)) ∧
      Nonempty K.subscheme
